candidates.source_description:
SBI Faces ₹5,000-a-Day Liability After Losing Borrower’s Property Papers

The Bombay High Court has directed the State Bank of India to compensate a Mumbai-based firm at ₹5,000 per day after the bank admitted that it could not locate original property documents deposited as loan security.

In Vogue Creations had submitted title papers for two industrial units in Prabhadevi and documents concerning an MIDC property in Taloja when obtaining credit facilities in 1979. The firm repaid its borrowing
